<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
Alagos runs a gaming community's week in one bot: events and sign-ups, who really came, the roster, loot, fair rotations and reports, with buttons instead of commands. Every server starts on **Free**, which is everything a league or guild needs to get going; **Premium** saves your officers time.

*(Community: coming later)*

## Events and sign-ups

- Events with sign-up buttons, reminders and a discussion thread; repeating events; your own event types and ready-made **templates**.
- **Role slots** (Tank / Healer / DPS, or your own), with a bench that moves up by itself.
- A **temporary role** for those signed up, taken away after the event.
- [**Scheduled announcements**](/guides/announcements/): messages Alagos posts for you, once or on a repeat.
- Free: 5 upcoming events, 3 repeating series, 3 templates of your own, 5 announcements. Premium: unlimited events and templates, 50 announcements.

## Attendance and reports

- **Confirmed attendance**: officers tick who really came, from name ranges or by name. Signing up is not attending.
- Attendance reports by member, by event type and week by week. Free: the last 30 days. Premium: all history, CSV export and a weekly summary for officers.

## The roster and characters

- A roster with leave, notes and referrals; members **claim** their character, or add their own where the game allows it; mains and alts.
- Premium: roster and attendance CSV import.

## Loot

- Free: **soft reserve**, **loot council** and **wishlists**, with tokens.
- Premium: points systems -- **DKP**, **Zero-Sum DKP** and **EPGP** -- with bidding, decay and a points board.

## Your server

- **Member and officer panels**: buttons for the things people do every week.
- **Role panels**: members press a button to take a role (Free 3, Premium 25).
- **Automatic roles**: a role for being on the roster or playing a game, given and taken by Alagos itself. Free. Roles for being on leave or for a rank are Premium.
- **A welcome flow**: one Start here button that walks newcomers through your rules, roles and characters. The basics are free; questions, your own wording and links are Premium.
- Personal notices by DM, anonymous feedback, permissions by role, and an audit trail.

## Games

Alagos supports games through modules you switch on. A module brings the game's own words, character details, event types and features. Free: 2 games at once. Premium: 5.

**DC Dark Legion**: the train and Guardian rotations, team assignments, Gotham and Krypton Rush seasons with Red Boxes, and the battle tracker.

More games are on their way; ask in the support server or the feature request forum which ones.

## Getting started

Add Alagos to your server at **alagos.gg/invite**, then follow [**Setting up Alagos**](/guides/setting-up/). Questions are welcome in the support server.

Alagos is not affiliated with or endorsed by the makers of the games it supports.
